property_summary: For any nonnegative amount, calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) on the correct contract sets betLimit to exactly amount (i.e., it replaces the old bet limit), whereas the mutant subtracts amount from the previous betLimit and thus will produce a different betLimit for some fuzzed amounts.
change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that subtracts the provided amount from the current betLimit.
